basics.name: Dmitry Leiko
basics.headline: Senior Backend Engineer · PHP / Python · Zend Certified Engineer
basics.summary: Backend engineer, 10+ years: PHP/Symfony and Python/Django. Since 2023 — microservices for one of the largest online retailers in Belarus: I design around DDD and own a service from its domain model to production on Kubernetes.
basics.location: Minsk, Belarus · Open to remote or relocation

experience.context: One of the largest online retailers in Belarus — electronics, appliances and a retail marketplace.
bullets: Build new microservices and maintain existing ones, modelling each around its business domain with Domain-Driven Design so services stay changeable as catalogue and order rules evolve.
Work mostly in the cart and delivery domain: how a cart is assembled and priced down to promo-code discounts, and which delivery methods and time slots a customer is offered at checkout.
Own services end to end: Symfony/PHP on MySQL and Redis, Kafka for inter-service messaging, shipped on Docker and Kubernetes.
Apply the maintainability practices the team relies on for long-lived code — layered domain models, explicit boundaries between services, and code review.

Use AI tooling day to day: Claude Code for code generation, review and getting up to speed in unfamiliar parts of the system — extended with skills and plugins I write myself, and with internal and external tools wired in over MCP.
Write Python tooling for analytics and data processing — pandas pipelines for reporting and ad-hoc analysis, scheduled and orchestrated with Airflow.

experience.context: Belarusian hosting, domain and cloud-services provider.
bullets: Extended the customer account area, where clients manage their hosting, domains and other services.
Integrated third-party APIs with internal services, keeping provider changes isolated from the products that depended on them.
Worked on a PHP/MySQL stack with ClickHouse for analytical queries, Redis caching, REST APIs and a Vue.js frontend, containerised with Docker.

experience.context: Custom software development company delivering client projects.
bullets: Estimated incoming work, built new functionality and evolved existing client projects in PHP (Symfony, Laravel) and Python.
Planned and distributed tasks for junior engineers on the team.

experience.context: International software engineering and IT-consulting firm.
bullets: Built projects from scratch and extended existing ones for enterprise clients across PHP (Symfony), Python and MySQL.
Delivered e-commerce work on WordPress/WooCommerce alongside custom application development.
Supported the company's products and resolved production failures promptly.
Integrated external services over APIs; worked across PHP (Laminas), MySQL and Python/Django.

experience.context: Independent contracting for web studios and direct clients.
bullets: Built HTML/CSS templates from PSD designs of varying complexity, from landing pages to multi-page company sites.

projects.name: find-apartment
projects.blurb: Rental-listing scanner for Kufar and Realt.by that de-duplicates against SQLite and pushes only unseen listings to Telegram with photos and coordinates; price and room filters are changed live by chat command.
bullets: Runs on a 10-minute schedule in Docker; a single-poller guard turns Telegram 409 conflicts into a clear startup refusal instead of silent message loss.
Typed and linted end to end — mypy, Ruff, and a GitHub Actions test and image-publish pipeline on every push.
